lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gupat pragat jaa kau araadhahi paun paanee dinas raat ||
lines.translation: The invisible and visible beings worship Him in adoration, along with wind and water, day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਖਿਅਤ੍ਰ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਸੂਰ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਬਸੁਧ ਗਗਨਾ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: nakhiatr saseear soor dhiaavahi basudh gaganaa gaavae ||
lines.translation: The stars, the moon and the sun meditate on Him; the earth and the sky sing to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਖਾਣੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal khaanee sagal baanee sadaa sadaa dhiaavae ||
lines.translation: All the sources of creation, and all languages meditate on Him, forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦਹ ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜਪਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: simrit puraan chatur bedah khat saasatr jaa kau japaat ||
lines.translation: The Simritees, the Puraanas, the four Vedas and the six Shaastras meditate on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: patit paavan bhagat vachhal naanak mileeai sa(n)g saat ||3||
lines.translation: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His Saints; O Nanak, He is met in the Society of the Saints. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਨਾਈ ਰਸਨਾ ਤੇਤ ਭਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jetee prabhoo janaaee rasanaa tet bhanee ||
lines.translation: As much as God has revealed to us, that much we can speak with our tongues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਜੋ ਸੇਵੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਗਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anajaanat jo sevai tetee nah jaai ganee ||
lines.translation: Those unknown ones who serve You cannot be counted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਅਗਨਤ ਅਥਾਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲ ਮੰਝੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: avigat aganat athaah thaakur sagal ma(n)jhe baaharaa ||
lines.translation: Imperishable, incalculable, and unfathomable is the Lord and Master; He is everywhere, inside and out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab jaachik ek daataa nah door sa(n)gee jaaharaa ||
lines.translation: We are all beggars, He is the One and only Giver; He is not far away, but is with us, ever-present.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਸਿ ਭਗਤ ਥੀਆ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੀਆ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਿਤ ਗਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vas bhagat theeaa mile jeeaa taa kee upamaa kit ganee ||
lines.translation: He is in the power of His devotees; those whose souls are united with Him - how can their praises be sung?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੀਸੁ ਸਾਧਹ ਧਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ihu daan maan naanak paae sees saadhah dhar charanee ||4||2||5||
lines.translation: May Nanak receive this gift and honor, of placing his head on the feet of the Holy Saints. ||4||2||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: udam karahu vadabhaageeho simarahu har har raai ||
lines.translation: Make the effort, O very fortunate ones, and meditate on the Lord, the Lord King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jis simarat sabh sukh hovahi dookh darad bhram jaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, remembering Him in meditation, you shall obtain total peace, and your pains and troubles and doubts shall depart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਹ ਅਲਸਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam japat gobi(n)d nah alasaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe; don't be lazy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਨਹ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhetat saadhoo sa(n)g jam pur nah jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not have to go to the City of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh darad na bhau biaapai naam simarat sad sukhee ||
lines.translation: Pain, trouble and fear will not afflict you; meditating on the Naam, a lasting peace is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas araadh har har dhiaai so prabh man mukhee ||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, worship the Lord in adoration; meditate on the Lord God in your mind and with your mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਰਸਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kripaal daiaal rasaal gun nidh kar daiaa sevaa laaeeai ||
lines.translation: O kind and compassionate Lord, O treasure of sublime essence, treasure of excellence, please link me to Your service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਹ ਅਲਸਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai naam japat gobi(n)d nah alasaaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak: may I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and not be lazy in chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paavan patit puneet naam nira(n)janaa ||
lines.translation: The Purifier of sinners is the Naam, the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਜਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam a(n)dher binaas giaan gur a(n)janaa ||
lines.translation: The darkness of doubt is removed by the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur giaan a(n)jan prabh nira(n)jan jal thal maheeal pooriaa ||
lines.translation: By the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom, one meets the Immaculate Lord God, who is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik nimakh jaa kai ridai vasiaa mite tisahi visooriaa ||
lines.translation: If He dwells within the heart, for even an instant, sorrows are forgotten.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: agaadh bodh samarath suaamee sarab kaa bhau bha(n)janaa ||
lines.translation: The wisdom of the all-powerful Lord and Master is incomprehensible; He is the Destroyer of the fears of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai paavan patit puneet naam nira(n)janaa ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet. The Purifier of sinners is the Naam, the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ot gahee gopaal daiaal kripaa nidhe ||
lines.translation: I have grasped the protection of the merciful Lord, the Sustainer of the Universe, the treasure of grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਆਸਰ ਤੁਅ ਚਰਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਿਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi aasar tu charan tumaaree saran sidhe ||
lines.translation: I take the support of Your lotus feet, and in the protection of Your Sanctuary, I attain perfection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har charan kaaran karan suaamee patit udharan har hare ||
lines.translation: The Lord's lotus feet are the cause of causes; the Lord Master saves even the sinners.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saagar sa(n)saar bhav utaar naam simarat bahu tare ||
lines.translation: So many are saved; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, contemplating the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸੁਨੀ ਉਧਰਨ ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਬਿਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad a(n)t bea(n)t khojahi sunee udharan sa(n)tasa(n)g bidhe ||
lines.translation: In the beginning and in the end, countless are those who seek the Lord. I have heard that the Society of the Saints is the way to salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਨ ਜੰਪੈ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai ot gahee gopaal daiaal kripaa nidhe ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and grasp the protection of the Lord of the Universe, the merciful, the ocean of kindness. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat vachhal har birad aap banaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; this is His natural way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਸੰਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah jah sa(n)t araadhahi tah tah pragataaiaa ||
lines.translation: Wherever the Saints worship the Lord in adoration, there He is revealed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਗਤ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh aap leee samaai sahaj subhaai bhagat kaaraj saariaa ||
lines.translation: God blends Himself with His devotees in His natural way, and resolves their affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਜਸ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਰਬ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aana(n)d har jas mahaa ma(n)gal sarab dookh visaariaa ||
lines.translation: In the ecstasy of the Lord's Praises, they obtain supreme joy, and forget all their sorrows.
